legacyComparison.semanticDifference: The 2016 rot parameter expresses full turns; the pinned 2021 alpha parameter is radians. They are not interchangeable.

sourceObservations: The 2-D field tiles for any positive integer x period and positive even integer y period.
An odd positive y period is accepted but the actual y repeat is twice that input.
A nonpositive period component independently disables wrapping on that axis.
Alpha rotates lattice gradients in radians; the function returns analytic spatial derivatives.
